notes: focused 0–4: Folded east/south/west source sheets removed; solid survey envelope and roof step retained. Individual lower openings/vent visible and clean. South gap view is very close to adjacent Siemensbau and is not whole-facade evidence. Tree occlusion and baked ground/roof colours remain.

focused 5–13: North/east walls now continuous with no detached mesh sheets; lower east openings and west recess/louver detail visible. Exact stepped roof retained. Close gap frame shows enlarged material grain and is not a whole-facade acceptance camera. Retained Siemensbau north/east views remain intact, with the previously folded RCM backdrop now solid.
full 0–5: Central ground/aerial layout, curved facade and promenade retained; TNT cut visible. No new wall noise or geometry loss in these views.
full 6–11: UYA, IAS, former Mensa terrace/retaining and paving remain intact. No new shader artifacts; unchanged source-colour seams and coarse distant surfaces remain.

full 12–21: Warehouse, Telefonzentrale west, COS facades and site furniture remain intact; RCM appears solid in the COS aerial context. Existing blue/yellow source-image stains near GRS and blurry distant buildings remain visible and unfinished.

full 22–27: GRS walls, glazed connectors, tower and aerial roof geometry retained. Untreated buildings outside the current survey rectangle remain conspicuously coarse in background views; this is a remaining coverage limitation, not solved by the RCM change.

full 28–39: GRS III louvers/tower/roof and courtyard path retained. Promenade and crosspaths intact; Galileo upper courtyard shows no renewed stripes. Nearby out-of-coverage buildings and source-ground colours remain coarse.
full 40–45: Galileo court floor/stairs, facade panels and reflections retained. Concrete walls remain clean without the prior periodic bands; aerial roofs and courtyard cut intact.

full 46–51: Galileo north facade, grade and both ramp approaches retained without new wall bands; blurred ground imagery and coarse neighbouring structures remain visible and outside this RCM checkpoint.
full 52–56: All five MLZ route views retain continuous panelled facades, aligned openings and roof geometry; neighbouring source meshes remain coarse. No RCM regression visible.

retainedEvidence.qualification: The 17 service code files and 11 shader files are byte-identical to dev.21. Standalone service tests and the detailed morning/evening/night/reload sequence were not rerun; new full-route lighting/TNT/collision checks are fresh on this package.

qualifications: Source-informed exterior, not an as-built model. Surveyed five-face envelope and four roof triangles are retained. Individual dark features guide a small set of estimated openings; classifications, dimensions, frames and recesses are approximate. Obscured lower south/east details remain unresolved and are represented by a closed wall. No interiors.
Two eastern approaches are partially tree-occluded; elevated and closer views supplement them. The narrow south gap camera is not whole-facade acceptance evidence.
Source-ground colours, roof photography and exact architectural details remain imperfect. Untreated neighbours and landscaping still need work.
Native collision uses the existing one-metre proxy grid; it does not reproduce small sill/louver details.
